brandComInfo.introduce:
南京梧舍设计事务所组建于2020年，位于南京，是一家基于原创，以超前的设计构思和稳健的服务实施为核心，专注于生活美学的设计与推广，致力于为人们创建鲜活、独特、不造作的空间的设计企业。Westruct是致力于提供全面空间美学设计、专门从事大型公共建筑室内的专业设计公司机构。
Westruct主要业务范围包括空间设计、建筑设计、景观设计、视觉设计和前期概念策划等。设计阶段涵盖了概念设计、方案设计、初步设计、深化设计，对于需求的项目还包括现场技术配合等全面的专业服务。

Westruct established it-self as a full-fledged design company in 2020 in Nanjing.   Every work undertaken by Westruct is unique in terms of ideology and perspective, delivering the best in class experience for your design requirement.  The spaces that we create are harmonious yet practical and elegant with innovation deep rooted into the design for the best and most rewarding experiences for our customers. Our goal is always to create designs tailored to our clients’ unique personal styles and practical needs. 
Westruct Design Studio is a private design company expertizing in both interior and exterior design, specializing in conceiving modern, high-caliber solutions for public commercial space design.  In terms of vision, Westruct is always in the inspirational thinking, continuous development and construction process to achieve the most outstanding achievements in its operation process.  We are always aiming for sustainable development, becoming one of the leading brands in the industry in the future.
Westruct combines planning, architecture, interior, landscape and visual design into a single profession – Inter - Disciplinary Practice.  Our designers successfully participate in projects from the initial concepts, planning, design, project coordination and practice management – always with precision, professionalism, attention to detail, exceptional customer service and expert project management skills.

jobInfo.postDescription:
1.室内设计、环境艺术或建筑相关专业牛业，本科及以上学历，有6个月或以上室内设计
工作经验；
2. 熟悉办公及AutoCAD、Sketchup等工作专业软件基本操作;
3.对设计原理、施工工艺、材料有一定的兴趣并愿意学习，有较好的审美能力;
4.领悟能力强，有良好的沟通能力、执行能力和团队协作能力，配合设计师完成日常工
作事物包含项目方案前期与整体落地执行;
5. 较强的抗压能力，能够积极地参与到设计团队中，积极主动，态度认真，有责任心。

Qualification:
i.Bachelor's degree or higher in interior and architecture design or related
majors, minimum 6 month of work experience in interior design.
ii. Familiar with Microsoft Office, AutoCAD, Sketchup and related software.
iii. Passionate about design, have peculiar taste of space design.
iv. Good interpersonal, communication and team cooperation skills; assist
and cooperate with the daily work of the direct supervisor, including the
preprogramming and overall implementaion of the project.
v. Good work coordination and can work wellunder pressure with a sense
of responsibility and teamwork.。
